content.title: Betterware (BWMX) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Before we begin our review, I would like to note that we are conducting today's webcast with a slide presentation to help better convey the relevant information that we want to share with you in our quarterly results conferences.  Despite the softer consumer environment in Mexico and the US, we delivered another quarter of growth, solid profitability, and strong cash generation.  During the quarter, revenue grew 1.4% year over year, and EBITDA grew 22%, with the margin expanding 362 basis points to 21.4% EBITDA.
